liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Scarlet rocks through the verses and jams pleasantly on the coda [7]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer hears a strange, three-dimensional synergy in the band during China Cat, best heard with a detached ear [10]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Truckin' and Eyes both reach plateaus of synergistic groove, according to the reviewer [7]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-09-20.131529.sbd.miller.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 199 min; rated 3.1/5 by 10 [1]
- **gd74-09-20.sbd.gasperini.5648.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 185 min; rated 3.75/5 by 20 [2]. Said about its sound: Garcia is very clear in the recording, while Bobby cannot be heard; at times it sounds like only Garcia, Keith and William; Soundboard source puts drums and Jerry up front; noise reduction and uneven instrument and vocal levels mar the sound; Reviewer's soundboard copy sounds great, with only a barely audible hum in the source and no mix problems [5][7][8]
- **gd1974-09-20.154273.s1.aud.flac1644**: audience recording; 12 songs; 89 min [3]. Said about its sound: Audience recording of only two songs, with significant hiss and poor venue acoustics [3]

## Around the show

- Citing Rock Scully's account of the European trip, reviewer says these two Palais Des Sports shows coincided with the band's introduction to China White heroin [11]
- Reviewer finds Jerry experimenting more than usual, with the rest of the band seeming less focused than normal [5]
- Reviewer considers the whole show a highlight of 1974 [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-09-20.131529.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat [1]. Also: Lossless soundboard transfer with seamless disc changes; one tape flip occurs at the end of Goin' Down The Road Feelin' Bad [1]
- **gd74-09-20.sbd.gasperini.5648.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1974-09-20.154273.s1.aud.flac1644**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Andrew F. 11/2021; source: Unknown mono Lo-Fi AUD, rescued from ebay with thanks to John Petrunis. [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by bootlegsworldwide.blogspot.com: [BOOTLEG : Grateful Dead - Palais des Sports, Paris, 20 September 1974 -SBD- (CD & Covers)](https://bootlegsworldwide.blogspot.com/2014/12/bootleg-grateful-dead-palais-des-sports.html) [17]
